title: Cosmic Muse Awakening
description: A translucent, ethereal female fairy-like figure with glowing wings and pink hair stands inside a large transparent glass sphere on a pedestal. From her head erupts a powerful swirling vortex of colorful ribbons, paint splashes, and bright energy that rises into a bright starburst against a dark cosmic background.
prompt: A luminous translucent fairy with butterfly wings and glowing pink hair stands centered inside a large transparent crystal sphere on a dark pedestal. A powerful swirling vortex of colorful ribbons, paint strokes, and energy in green, pink, blue and purple explodes upward from her head into a bright starburst against a dark cosmic background with floating orbs and dynamic paint splashes.
